disease: Factor V Leiden thrombophilia (F5 R506Q -- activated protein C resistance; THPH2)

emergence.disease: Factor V Leiden thrombophilia (F5 R506Q -- activated protein C resistance; THPH2)
emergence.summary: The commonest heritable thrombophilia: a recurrent F5 gain-of-function (R506Q / Arg506Gln, 'factor V Leiden') abolishes the first activated-protein-C (APC) cleavage site on activated factor V, so the procoagulant accelerator cofactor resists inactivation -> the coagulation drive cannot be braked by the protein C/APC pathway -> venous-thrombosis propensity UP.

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: R506Q (Arg506Gln, factor V Leiden) removes the first of the three APC cleavage sites (Arg506/Arg306/Arg679) on activated factor V (factor Va), rendering the procoagulant cofactor APC-RESISTANT -- factor Va stays active far longer, so the procoagulant accelerator cannot be down-regulated by the protein C / APC brake (a functional gain on the procoagulant axis; the accelerator that resists its own brake)
per_gene.src: Bertina 1994 Nature 369:64 (factor V Leiden / APC resistance); Dahlback 1993 PNAS 90:1004

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

treatment_A_switch.disease: Factor V Leiden thrombophilia (F5 R506Q -- activated protein C resistance; THPH2)

levers.push_direction: lower DOWNSTREAM thrombin (and factor Xa) generation by general anticoagulation, pushing the over-driven coagulation axis back toward normal -> reduced venous-thrombosis propensity. Acts DOWNSTREAM of the APC-resistant factor Va and does NOT restore APC sensitivity at F5 (it bypasses the switch defect rather than repairing it); net axis effect RESTRAIN
levers.agent_class: general anticoagulant (vitamin-K antagonist warfarin; direct oral factor Xa inhibitor [rivaroxaban / apixaban] or direct thrombin inhibitor [dabigatran])
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] off-causal-gene DOWNSTREAM anticoagulant; the link from thrombin/FXa inhibition to the corrected coagulation axis is haemostasis pharmacology the gamma read does not capture. Approved for venous-thromboembolism treatment / prophylaxis (the manifestation) -- NOT an F5-targeted agent; whether, when and how intensely to anticoagulate any individual is a clinical risk-stratification decision, asserted nowhere here
levers.src: Kearon 2016 Chest 149:315 (antithrombotic therapy for VTE); warfarin / DOACs approved for VTE -- no factor-V-Leiden-targeted therapy exists

levers.push_direction: restore APC sensitivity of factor Va itself -- re-impose the protein C / APC brake on the procoagulant accelerator at the causal switch (the DIRECTION the switch forces) -> coagulation drive held down toward normal; net axis effect RESTRAIN (gene/function-level correction of the causal gene)
levers.agent_class: F5-Leiden APC-sensitivity restoration (allele-specific correction / APC-pathway restoration; investigational, no approved agent)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of restored APC sensitivity not derived from sequence; this is the forced switch-level direction, but NO approved agent restores factor Va APC sensitivity -- investigational only
levers.src: APC-resistance mechanism (Bertina 1994); recombinant activated protein C [drotrecogin alfa] was withdrawn 2011 -- no approved factor-V-Leiden-specific corrective

falsifiers.claim: F5 R506Q (factor V Leiden) moves the coagulation emergent axis UP (procoagulant accelerator resists its brake)
falsifiers.falsifier: an F5 R506Q allele that SHORTENS thrombin generation / REDUCES venous-thrombosis incidence, or factor Va inactivated FASTER by APC despite R506Q, refutes the procoagulant-GOF (axis UP) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: calibrated automated thrombography (thrombin-generation assay) and the APC-resistance ratio stratified by F5 genotype; venous-thromboembolism incidence cohort by genotype

falsifiers.claim: general (downstream) anticoagulation is the CORRECTIVE direction (restrains the over-driven axis) but does NOT restore APC sensitivity
falsifiers.falsifier: if lowering thrombin/FXa generation raised rather than reduced thrombosis the 'restrain the axis' lever sign is wrong; if an anticoagulant were shown to restore factor Va APC sensitivity the 'downstream / does-not-repair-the-switch' classification is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: VTE recurrence on vs off anticoagulation in factor-V-Leiden carriers; APC-resistance ratio before/after anticoagulant exposure

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
